subject: Mutual action plan — restricted testcases & promptpack transfer: roadmap and takedown cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Lila Vega <lila@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Mutual action plan — restricted testcases & promptpack transfer: roadmap and takedown cadence

Hi Lila,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff earlier. As discussed, attached is a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) for the exchange of the restricted testcases and the promptpack for the ZephyrPilot trial. High-level goals: get a small, scoped promptpack + 500 sanitized testcases into your secure sandbox for 2 weeks of acceptance testing, then a short review window, followed by a controlled takedown and certificate of destruction.

Key asks from our side:
- Zephyr to confirm a single technical contact and a procurement contact for DocuSign.
- Accept the temporary, non-transferable license and the ephemeral access constraints (no redistribution, access limited to named users).
- Audit log delivery: we will request a one-week rolling log export after the trial.

I attached a working spreadsheet with milestones and a short checklist (zephyr_map_v1.xlsx). Please review and tell us if the timeline below works for you. If it does, we can convert to a formal MAP and route DocuSign.

Proposed timeline (example sprint):
- May 12: provide sandbox credentials and tech contact; sign MAP draft
- May 13: Redwood pushes sanitized sample testcases and promptpack metadata
- May 14–27: Zephyr acceptance testing (2-week window)
- May 28–29: joint QA notes and sign-off window
- June 1: scheduled takedown; provide destruction certificate by June 3

Constraints and guardrails (short):
- No replication or sharing of raw testcases outside Zephyr test sandbox
- Model evaluation allowed; any published results referencing Redwood-supplied testcases must be cleared in advance
- Ephemeral keys expire automatically after takedown; we will ask for confirmation once revoked

If that timeline looks good, Marissa will follow up with the checklist and the promptpack checksum.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Onboarding, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — restricted testcases & promptpack transfer: roadmap and takedown cadence

Thanks, Irene — this looks sensible and appreciated. A few quick clarifications from our end before we sign:

1) Technical contact: I will loop in Rafael (r.mendes@zephyr.ai) for the sandbox creds; Rafael will be the named user for access requests.
2) Procurement: our procurement team (procurement@zephyr.ai) needs the MAP as a PDF and a one-page statement of data use / no-redistribution to attach to our PO.
3) Audit logs: minimal ask — can you confirm the log format (json vs csv) and whether events include token-level counts?

We are fine with the 2-week acceptance window; one ask: can Redwood provide a small, curated subset (50 testcases) in advance so our engineers can sanity-check ingest before the full set? If possible, please mark those as "sanitized-sample-50".

Happy to move to DocuSign once those items are linked in the MAP.

Best,
Lila Vega
Head of Evaluation, Zephyr AI
lila@zephyr.ai

Lila / Rafael —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the sample and for confirming Rafael as the tech lead. Two quick next steps to finalize the MAP so Procurement can issue the PO:

1) DocuSign: Marissa has prepared the MAP bundle and uploaded it to DocuSign (link below). Rafael / procurement, please confirm signer and we will route.
2) Security checklist: to be explicit about usage constraints before signature:
   - Access: ephemeral, named IAM users only; no sharing of keys; we will revoke on takedown date.
   - Logs: we will provide an export of the sandbox access log in CSV with per-request timestamps; token-level counts are provided as an aggregate column (tokens_in, tokens_out).
   - Data retention: logs retained for 30 days; testcases removed on takedown; Redwood will provide a signed destruction certificate within 72 hours after takedown.
   - Publication: Zephyr may publish evaluation results, but any appendix listing Redwood-supplied testcases or verbatim prompt text requires prior written approval.

If those items are acceptable, Rafael / procurement can sign the DocuSign envelope and we will proceed with the full package delivery on May 14 as planned. For the IP allowlist vs VPN note: if you prefer VPN we can provide connection details; otherwise we can accept an explicit IP list.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/Start?doc=ZEPHYR-MAP-4312
Drive folder (MAP docs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-zephyr-map

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Irene
